answer: An agent marketplace requires each trading identity to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before bidding, with each bond backing only one identity. Whether agents buy tundra maps, book a falcon survey, or appraise a relic, the same rule applies. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must lock 100,000 tokens for the full period. Splitting a wallet creates no extra bidding power without extra collateral, making a swarm costly in tied-up capital.
